scripts.build: npm run export:handbook && npm run export:library && next build --webpack
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:local && npm run check:artifact && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path contracts/sunset/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/sunset/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --offline --manifest-path contracts/sunset/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && bash contracts/sunset/scripts/build.sh && npm run check:artifact
scripts.test:release:local: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:pages && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:release: npm run test:release:local && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run test:browser
